questionText:

some basic features of the Constitution and the Parliament cannot amend
these features. Identify the case.

Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Crises of the Constitutional Order (The Crisis of Democratic Order):

In Kesavananda Bharati v. Hence, option (A) is correct.
